aggregation: one official score per held-out context, drug, and dose; context and drug fixed effects; drug-cluster bootstrap
axis_name: Tahoe administered-dose displacement on official STATE score
confirmation_set: official ST-HVG-Tahoe few-shot eval_best score tables for C32, HOP62, HepG2-C3A, Hs 766T, and PANC-1; none read before this freeze
controls: official held-out number of significant DE genes
deduplication: one normalized context-drug-dose row from each official result table
direction: lower administered dose predicts lower STATE performance
distance_metric: negative base-10 log dose in uM, standardized over the three balanced levels
error_spending_plan: one primary ST-HVG best-checkpoint dose test; ST-SE and last-checkpoint tables are labeled sensitivities and cannot rescue a failed primary test
fixed_reference: equal-training-cell-line mean Tahoe pseudobulk LFC vector for the same drug-dose, scored against the same held-out real response over the same significant-real-DE genes; it consumes no held-out outcome when constructing predictions
gene_set: the official released significant-real-DE gene set used by de_spearman_lfc_sig for each target condition; no outcome-dependent condition exclusion
hypothesis_source: pre-target mechanistic candidate required by the audit brief; separated from the unfinished expected-magnitude transport
inclusion_exclusion: intersection of the five official test lists; retain the 199 drugs having all three doses in every held-out context; vehicle excluded; require finite official score and report any missing rows
level_rule: three pre-existing experimental levels in fixed order 5.0, 0.5, 0.05 uM; no binning
mechanism_gate: adjust for held-out nDE and cell support; if these absorb dose, reattribute the mechanism to response magnitude or measurement floor while retaining experimentally administered dose as the prospective proxy
metric: official de_spearman_lfc_sig; primary coefficient is Fisher-z score on standardized negative log dose with drug and context fixed effects
normalization: official cell-eval signed log-fold-change Spearman score; Fisher z for regression
power_plan: single target look using all 199 complete drug clusters; 10,000 cluster bootstrap draws preserving each sampled drug's three doses and five contexts; no subgroup tuning
prospective_features: ordered administered concentration within each drug: 5.0, 0.5, and 0.05 uM
reference_gate: after a real STATE degradation is established, classify STATE as larger, comparable, or smaller than the fixed-reference degradation; reference degradation does not reject a shared failure
sample_size_target: at least 150 complete drug clusters and all available held-out contexts; planned maximum 199 drugs and 2,985 units
success_criteria: certify directional degradation only if the primary dose coefficient 95% drug-block bootstrap interval is above zero for increasing weakness (negative log dose) and mean performance at 0.05 uM is below 5.0 uM; retain a real shared degradation regardless of the reference direction
target_access_state: drafted after confirming locally that no Tahoe result, pred_de, real_de, or agg_results table had been accessed
unit: held-out Tahoe cell line x drug x dose
